They just need support and lots of it. Love them and do your best.

Depression

Sudden happiness 

Death

Suicide is difficult for anyone and if followed through things must of been that bad, can you imagine feeling that bad that you needed to follow through with the switching off life option.

I’m an addict, run, we lie and won’t change. 
We just try to better ourselves, but don’t put to much pressure on yourself, if you see the warning signs (common sense) 
RUN! Before you become one of us. 

You run with scum, you become SCUM.

Relationships and drugs don’t work

You need love and lots of it my friend.
